key_result: In the authors' low-productivity scenario, losses reach 16.8 trillion dollars across shareholders and creditors with 40% loss-given-default on debt; debt funds nearly 60% of the expansion.
takeaway: Maps the debt and equity claims that fund the AI compute buildout and models how losses would spread among them.
title: Clouds of Credit: Mapping the Financial Web Behind AI Compute
why_it_matters: It quantifies credit exposure to AI data-centre investment, a question usually argued without a network model.
